Fact.Name: Paid interest on a car loan
Fact.Description: #53 gate: paid or accrued interest in the tax year on a loan to buy a vehicle for personal use.

Fact.Name: Gate answered yes
Fact.Description: #53: true only when /carLoanHadInterest is answered yes; unanswered counts as no so existing returns stay complete.

Fact.Name: Vehicles with qualifying loan interest
Fact.Description: #69: one item per vehicle (Schedule 1-A line 28a, 28b, ...). 163(h)(4)(B)(iii) requires a VIN for each.

Fact.Name: Original use began with the filer
Fact.Description: #53: Schedule 1-A line 28a(1) "Did the original use of this vehicle start with you, or your spouse if married filing jointly (a used vehicle does not qualify)?" 163(h)(4)(D)(i) "the original use of which commences with the taxpayer". No: knockout (used vehicle).

Fact.Name: Final assembly in the United States
Fact.Description: #53: line 28a(2) "Did final assembly of this vehicle occur within the United States". 163(h)(4)(D): "Such term shall not include any vehicle the final assembly of which did not occur within the United States." No: not QPVLI, $0.

Fact.Name: Final assembly not in the United States (PDF)
Fact.Description: #66: Schedule 1-A line 28a(2)/28b(2) "No" checkbox. Complement of ../usAssembly; incomplete while that is unanswered (no silent false).

Fact.Name: Loan taken out after December 31, 2024
Fact.Description: #53: 163(h)(4)(B)(i) "indebtedness incurred by the taxpayer after December 31, 2024". No: not QPVLI, $0.

Fact.Name: Any business use of the vehicle or interest deducted on Schedule C, E, or F
Fact.Description: #53: 163(h)(4)(B)(i) "for personal use"; line 28 column (ii) "Deducted on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F". Allocation is out of MVP scope. Yes: knockout.

Fact.Name: Lease
Fact.Description: #53: 163(h)(4)(B)(ii)(III) "Any lease financing." Yes: knockout.

Fact.Name: Other cases not supported
Fact.Description: #53/#69: not secured by a first lien (B)(i); fleet sale (B)(ii)(I); salvage title (IV); scrap or parts (V); refinanced for more than the original loan (E)(ii); loan from a related person (E)(iii); not a car, minivan, van, SUV, pickup or motorcycle, or 14,000 pounds or more (D)(iv), (vi). Yes: knockout.

Fact.Name: Vehicle identification number (PII)
Fact.Description: #53: line 28 column (i). 163(h)(4)(B)(iii): "Interest shall not be treated as qualified passenger vehicle loan interest under this paragraph unless the taxpayer includes the vehicle identification number of the applicable passenger vehicle described in clause (i) on the return of tax for the taxable year." 17 characters; letters I, O and Q are never used in a VIN.

Fact.Name: Interest paid on the loan
Fact.Description: #53: line 28 column (iii), interest paid or accrued in the tax year (Form 1098-VLI box 1 may help).

Fact.Name: Knockout: used vehicle (this vehicle)
Fact.Description: #53: line 28a(1) answered no. 163(h)(4)(D)(i). #69: evaluated per vehicle.

Fact.Name: Knockout: used vehicle
Fact.Description: #53: line 28a(1) answered no. 163(h)(4)(D)(i). #69: true when the gate is yes and any vehicle in /carLoans hits this stop.

Fact.Name: Knockout: business use (this vehicle)
Fact.Description: #53: personal-use allocation and Schedule C/E/F column (ii) are out of scope. 163(h)(4)(B)(i). #69: evaluated per vehicle.

Fact.Name: Knockout: business use
Fact.Description: #53: personal-use allocation and Schedule C/E/F column (ii) are out of scope. 163(h)(4)(B)(i). #69: true when the gate is yes and any vehicle in /carLoans hits this stop.

Fact.Name: Knockout: lease (this vehicle)
Fact.Description: #53: 163(h)(4)(B)(ii)(III). #69: evaluated per vehicle.

Fact.Name: Knockout: lease
Fact.Description: #53: 163(h)(4)(B)(ii)(III). #69: true when the gate is yes and any vehicle in /carLoans hits this stop.

Fact.Name: Knockout: other unsupported car loan cases (this vehicle)
Fact.Description: #53: see /carLoans/*/hasOtherExceptions. #69: evaluated per vehicle.

Fact.Name: Knockout: other unsupported car loan cases
Fact.Description: #53: see /carLoans/*/hasOtherExceptions. #69: true when the gate is yes and any vehicle in /carLoans hits this stop.

Fact.Name: Knockout: more than two vehicles
Fact.Description: #66: draft 2026 Schedule 1-A line 28 has rows for two vehicles only ("Applicable passenger vehicle (see instructions). If more than two VINs, see instructions."), and 163(h)(4)(B)(iii) disallows the interest unless each VIN is on the return. Until a continuation statement exists, a gate-yes return with more than 2 entries in /carLoans is stopped.

Fact.Name: This vehicle's interest is QPVLI
Fact.Description: #53/#69 (per vehicle): new vehicle, US final assembly, loan after 2024, no business use, lease or other exception. Unanswered questions leave this incomplete (no silent $0). The VIN (163(h)(4)(B)(iii)) is a required field per vehicle on the amount screen; it does not enter the computation.

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 28 column (iii), this vehicle
Fact.Description: #69: this vehicle's row (28a, 28b, ...) column (iii) "Schedule 1-A" interest: ../writableInterest when the vehicle is QPVLI, $0 when it is not (foreign final assembly or pre-2025 loan, 163(h)(4)(D) and (B)(i)). Incomplete while any answer is missing (no silent $0). #202: rounded to whole dollars, because the row prints on its own line and lines 29 and 30 are figured from the rows. Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), p. 23, Rounding Off to Whole Dollars: "If you do round to whole dollars, you must round all amounts. To round, drop amounts under 50 cents and increase amounts from 50 to 99 cents to the next dollar." 26 U.S.C. 6102(a) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/6102) rounds half up.

Fact.Name: Vehicle entry complete
Fact.Description: #69: every per-vehicle answer, the VIN (163(h)(4)(B)(iii)) and the interest are entered.

Fact.Name: Vehicle loop done
Fact.Description: #69: filer finished adding vehicles.

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 29
Fact.Description: #53/#69: line 29 "Add lines 28a and 28b, column (iii)", summed over every vehicle in /carLoans. #202: the rows are already whole dollars, so line 29 equals the printed 28a + 28b. $0 when the gate is unanswered or no. Gate yes with no vehicle entered has no value (incomplete), so it cannot become a silent $0.

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 30
Fact.Description: #53: line 30 "Enter the smaller of the amount on line 29 or $10,000". 163(h)(4)(C)(i): "shall not exceed $10,000". #69: applied once to the all-vehicle total (per return, not per vehicle).

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 32
Fact.Description: #53: line 32 "Enter $100,000 ($200,000 if married filing jointly)". 163(h)(4)(C)(ii)(I).

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 33
Fact.Description: #53: line 33 "Subtract line 32 from line 31" (line 31 = line 3, MAGI), not below zero.

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 34
Fact.Description: #66: printed value of line 34 "Divide line 33 by $1,000. If the resulting number isn't a whole number, increase the result to the next higher whole number." Same rounding as /carLoanLine35 (add $999.99, then whole thousands), rate 1/1000 instead of 200/1000, so line 35 = line 34 x $200.

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A lines 34-35 (phaseout)
Fact.Description: #53: line 34 "Divide line 33 by $1,000. If the resulting number isn't a whole number, increase the result to the next higher whole number. (For example, increase 1.5 to 2, and increase 0.05 to 1.)"; line 35 "Multiply line 34 by $200". Matches 163(h)(4)(C)(ii)(I): "reduced (but not below zero) by $200 for each $1,000 (or portion thereof) by which the modified adjusted gross income of the taxpayer for the taxable year exceeds $100,000 ($200,000 in the case of a joint return)". Rounding up uses the ctcOdc.xml pattern: add $999.99, then StepwiseMultiply by 200/1000 (whole thousands times $200).

Fact.Name: Schedule 1-A line 36
Fact.Description: #53: line 36 "Qualified passenger vehicle loan interest deduction. Subtract line 35 from line 30. If zero or less, enter -0-".
